stack: Next.js (latest, App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui + Framer Motion (motion) + Zustand (persist to localStorage, seeded from lib/mock/) + sonner + lucide-react + maplibre-gl via react-map-gl/maplibre with a keyless OpenFreeMap style + Geist font + one Playwright smoke spec, deployed on Vercel. No Neon/Drizzle: the PRD puts all data client-side as mocks and lists a database as a non-goal.

features.title: App shell + design tokens + deploy pipeline green (Covers: Next.js App Router, Tailwind/shadcn tokens (brand color #00A86B, Geist font), a Zustand persist store skeleton seeded from lib/mock/, formatFCFA, sonner, /login splash, bottom nav and sidebar layouts, stub pages for Explorer and Compte, and a Vercel deploy.)
acceptance: AC1: Visiting /login shows a splash with a "Continuer" button. Clicking it lands on /.

AC2: At a 390px viewport, a bottom nav shows Accueil, Explorer, Activité, Wallet and Compte. At 1280px, a left sidebar and a top bar (logo, search field, bell, avatar) replace it. All 5 tabs can be reached in both layouts. The active tab has a filled icon and a bold label, so it isn't marked by colour alone.
AC3: Going to any tab and pressing browser back returns to the previous tab.

AC4: Visiting /account shows "Abed-Négo", "Utilisateur Gold", "+229 97 12 34 56" and a "Réinitialiser la démo" button. Clicking the button clears localStorage, restores the seed data (wallet 125 500 FCFA, 2 450 pts) and shows a toast.
AC5: The production Vercel URL returns 200. The Playwright smoke spec (visit /, see "Bonjour Abed") passes in CI or locally. Each later feature adds its demo step to this spec.

features.title: Home
acceptance: AC1: Visiting / shows "Bonjour Abed 👋", "📍 Cotonou", a bell with an unread-count badge, an avatar, "Que voulez-vous faire ?" and a big "Où allez-vous ?" card.

AC2: The services grid shows 8 tiles: Se déplacer, Manger, Courses, Envoyer, Gaz, Gozem Money, Billetterie, Crédit. Each tile has an icon, a name and a short description. Tapping Billetterie, Crédit, Courses or Gaz opens a "Bientôt disponible" sheet.
AC3: Tapping "Où allez-vous ?" or "Se déplacer" navigates to /ride/search. Tapping "Manger" navigates to /food.
AC4: Tapping the Maison quick action goes straight to /ride/options with "Vers Maison" in the sheet header.
AC5: The promo carousel shows 4 cards and can be scrolled horizontally.

features.title: Ride search → vehicle options → confirm
acceptance: AC1: Visiting /ride/search shows a full-screen MapLibre map centred on Cotonou, or a tinted background if tiles fail. The Destination input is autofocused, and chips for Maison, Travail and Lieu récent are shown.
AC2: Typing "aeroport" (no accent) lists "Aéroport International de Cotonou" first, with the subtitle "Cadjehoun". Typing "zzzz" shows an empty-result message.

AC3: Selecting the airport opens /ride/options. The map shows a route polyline and idle vehicles. The sheet reads "Vers Aéroport de Cotonou · 12 min · 4.8 km" and lists: Zem 1 500 FCFA / 4 min; Tricycle 2 000 FCFA / 7 min; Taxi 3 000 FCFA / 9 min; Gozem Comfort 4 500 FCFA / 10 min. Selecting Taxi changes the price shown under "Prix estimé … Prix garanti*" to 3 000 FCFA.

AC4: "⚙ Options" opens a sheet with Maintenant (selected), Aujourd'hui, Demain and Choisir une date (native date/time inputs). "+ Ajouter un arrêt" adds a stop, which raises the displayed price and ETA. The maximum is 2 stops.

AC5: The CTA leads to /ride/confirm. It shows "Confirmer votre trajet", Ma position → Aéroport, Zem, 1 500 FCFA, the default payment method Gozem Money, and a "Confirmer le trajet" button that leads to /ride/matching.

features.title: Matching + live tracking (hero screen)
acceptance: AC1: /ride/matching shows a radar pulse and "Recherche d'un chauffeur...". After about 1.5 s it shows "Recherche de chauffeurs à proximité". After about 3 s it shows "Chauffeur trouvé ✓" with the card "Koffi A. ⭐ 4.9 · 1 284 trajets · Honda Wave · AB 1234 RB". "Annuler" during the search returns to options.

AC2: After the driver is found, the page goes to /ride/tracking. The sheet reads "Koffi arrive dans 3 min". With no user interaction, the driver marker's screen position changes at least 3 times in 6 s, and it rotates to face its heading.

AC3: The ETA and distance numbers go down over time. Without any user input, the status moves through "Votre chauffeur est arrivé", then "En route vers Aéroport … · arrivée HH:MM", then completion, which navigates to /ride/complete.
AC4: "Simuler l'arrivée" jumps straight to /ride/complete. Message opens a chat sheet with canned driver replies. Appeler opens a call sheet with a running timer.
AC5: Reloading /ride/tracking mid-trip keeps the same driver and phase, because the store is persisted.

features.title: Safety center + share trip
acceptance: AC1: On tracking, "🛡 Sécurité" opens the "Votre sécurité" panel with ✓ GPS, ✓ Chauffeur identifié, ✓ Véhicule identifié, and the actions Partager mon trajet, Contacter un proche, Assistance and Urgence.

AC2: Partager mon trajet → Copier le lien puts text containing "gozem.app/t/8K92X" on the clipboard and shows the toast "Trajet partagé ✓". The WhatsApp option opens a wa.me link with the prefilled message.
AC3: Urgence shows a confirmation dialog. Confirming shows "Alerte envoyée" with a countdown and an "Annuler" button.

features.title: Ride completion, rating, tip, receipt + side effects
acceptance: AC1: /ride/complete shows "Vous êtes arrivé 🎉", 1 500 FCFA and "Payé avec Gozem Money". A receipt shows Course 1 300 + Frais 200 = 1 500 FCFA with the date and time.
AC2: Tapping the 5th star, the tags Ponctuel and Sympathique, and tip 500 highlights each selection. Télécharger shows a toast.
AC3: "Terminer" navigates to /. The bell badge count has gone up by 1.
AC4: After Terminer and a page reload: /wallet shows 125 500 − 1 500 − 500 = 123 500 FCFA; /gowin shows 2 500 pts; /activity lists the airport ride under "Aujourd'hui".

features.title: Food: browse, restaurant, cart
acceptance: AC1: /food shows "Que voulez-vous manger ?", a search field, category chips (Burgers, Pizza, Poulet, Asiatique, Healthy, Desserts) and at least 8 restaurant cards with image, rating, time, fee and distance. This includes Burger House and Chez Maman Bénin. Tapping "Burgers" hides Chez Maman Bénin.
AC2: /food/burger-house has sticky section tabs (Populaire, Burgers, Menus, Boissons, Desserts). Tapping a tab scrolls to that section.
AC3: Adding Classic Burger ×2 and Coca ×2 with the steppers shows the toast "Ajouté au panier ✓". The cart sheet shows subtotal 8 000 FCFA, delivery 1 000 FCFA and total 9 000 FCFA.
AC4: The cart survives a page reload.

features.title: Group order ("Commander ensemble")
acceptance: AC1: On Burger House, "👥 Commander ensemble" opens a form with budget max, date limite, and the payment choices "Je paie pour tout le monde" or "Chacun paie sa part". Submitting it shows the link gozem.app/group/X92K with Copier and Partager buttons. Copier shows a toast.
AC2: /food/group/X92K shows Abed's items. Within about 6 s and without any interaction, Aïcha and then Rodrigue appear and add items. Each person's subtotal updates, and the budget bar fills up.
AC3: A "Retour au panier" control returns to the regular cart, where the total is still 9 000 FCFA.

features.title: Food checkout + order tracking
acceptance: AC1: /food/checkout shows the address "Maison (Abomey-Calavi)", payment Gozem Money and a total of 9 000 FCFA. "Payer" shows a processing state for about 1.2 s, then an animated success checkmark and the toast "Paiement réussi ✓".
AC2: The page then goes to /food/order/[id]. Its timeline moves on its own through Restaurant confirme → Préparation → Coursier assigné → En livraison → Livré.
AC3: Starting from the F06 end state, the wallet shows 114 500 FCFA afterwards. /activity lists the Burger House order, and the bell badge count goes up.
AC4: If the wallet balance is below the total, "Payer" shows an insufficient-funds error and nothing is debited.

features.title: Wallet, Activity, GoWin, Notifications (demo step 13)
acceptance: AC1: /wallet shows the balance, which the eye toggle can hide and show again. It has the actions Envoyer, Recevoir (QR + number sheet), Payer, Recharger and Retirer. Payer, Recharger and Retirer at least open a sheet with a toast. The transaction list shows the ride and food debits at the top.

AC2: /activity has the tabs Tout, Trajets, Commandes, Livraisons and Paiements, with entries grouped under Aujourd'hui, Hier and earlier. "Trajets" shows only rides. A tab with no entries shows an empty state. Tapping an entry opens /activity/[id] with a receipt-style detail.
AC3: /gowin shows the points total, the Gold level and a progress bar. Redeeming "500 pts → 500 FCFA de réduction" subtracts 500 pts, shows a toast and adds an entry to the points history.
AC4: /notifications lists the ride and order notifications as unread. "Tout marquer comme lu" clears the bell badge on /.

features.title: Scheduled ride + wallet transfer (secondary script)
acceptance: AC1: Home "Réserver un trajet" → Demain, 07:00 → Maison → Aéroport → confirm shows "Trajet programmé ✓ Demain à 07:00" and "✓ Chauffeur assigné avant votre départ".
AC2: /activity shows that ride under "À venir". Cancelling it removes it and shows a toast.

AC3: /wallet/send rejects a number that isn't in +229 format. For a valid number it then asks for the amount 10 000 and a message. The confirmation reads "Envoyer 10 000 FCFA à Koffi A.". Any 4-digit PIN leads to success, and the balance drops by 10 000.
AC4: An amount above the balance shows an insufficient-funds error at the PIN step, and the balance stays the same.

features.title: Parcel delivery (secondary script)
acceptance: AC1: Home "Envoyer" → /delivery form with retrait, destinataire nom/téléphone, adresse, Moto/Voiture and description. Submitting it shows a price of 1 500 FCFA and a "Commander un coursier" button.

AC2: Ordering shows "Coursier Jean assigné" and goes to /delivery/tracking. This page reuses the tracking map with a moving marker and the timeline ✓ Commande créée ✓ Coursier assigné ✓ Colis récupéré ● En livraison ○ Livré, for Colis #GZ-2841.
AC3: The timeline reaches "Livré" on its own. The wallet is debited 1 500 FCFA, and /activity → Livraisons lists #GZ-2841.

features.title: In-trip multi-stop + change destination, promotions page with working -20% promo, Explorer global search
acceptance: AC1: On /ride/tracking, '+ Ajouter un arrêt' adds up to 2 stops (e.g. Fidjrossè, Erevan); price and ETA shown in the sheet update and the route redraws. A 3rd stop is refused with a message.
AC2: 'Modifier destination' → choose Akpakpa → sheet shows 'Nouveau prix' with '+500 FCFA' and 'Confirmer'; after confirm the destination label reads Akpakpa.
AC3: /promotions ('Offres pour vous') lists ≥3 offers; activating '-20% sur votre prochaine course' then opening ride options to the airport shows Zem at 1 200 FCFA with a promo tag.

AC4: Explorer tab search: typing 'burger' shows categorised results with headings Restaurants (Burger House) and Produits/Services where relevant; typing 'aero' shows a Lieux result that opens ride options.

features.title: Account subpages + help center + UX states
acceptance: AC1: /account links to Informations personnelles (editing name persists after reload), Adresses (list Maison/Travail/Université; '+ Nouvelle adresse' form saves and shows toast 'Adresse enregistrée ✓'), Moyens de paiement (radio Gozem Money/Cash/Mobile Money, choice persists and is preselected in ride confirm), Sécurité (contacts de confiance), Langue (Français selected, others 'Bientôt').
AC2: /help shows 'Comment pouvons-nous vous aider ?', search, categories Trajet/Commande/Paiement/Compte/Sécurité and quick actions; 'Contacter le support' opens a mock chat that replies within 2 s.

AC3: A demo toggle 'Simuler hors connexion' in account shows the banner 'Vous êtes hors connexion.' on all pages; a toggle 'Simuler une erreur' makes /food show 'Une erreur est survenue.' with a 'Réessayer' button that recovers.
AC4: /food and /activity show skeletons while mock services load; an Activité tab with no entries shows an empty state message.
AC5: /manifest.webmanifest (or manifest.json) served with name 'Gozem Next', theme_color #00A86B, display standalone and icons.

features.title: Gaz, Courses (shopping) and QR pay
acceptance: AC1: /gas shows 'Votre bouteille est vide ?', sizes 6 kg / 12,5 kg / Petite bouteille, Bouteille neuve vs Recharge with distinct prices, livraison fee and ETA '30-45 min'; ordering debits the wallet and shows a tracking timeline that auto-advances to Livré.

AC2: /shopping shows categories (Épicerie, Boissons, Hygiène, Maison, Téléphones, Électronique) filtering product cards (Riz 5kg 4 500 FCFA, Huile 1L 1 800 FCFA, Lait 1 200 FCFA…); adding items and checking out debits the wallet and adds an Activité entry.
AC3: /wallet/pay 'Scanner un QR' shows an animated viewfinder; after ~2 s shows 'Burger House · 8 500 FCFA · Payer' → PIN → success; balance drops by 8 500.

features.title: Gozem Assistant (realistic scripted intent assistant)
acceptance: AC1: A '✨ Gozem Assistant' button is reachable from home (and desktop top bar) and opens /assistant chat with suggestion chips.

AC2: 'Je veux aller à l'aéroport demain à 7h' → typing indicator then a streamed reply with a booking card (Maison → Aéroport, Demain 07:00, Zem 1 500 FCFA); its button opens the scheduled-ride confirmation prefilled.
AC3: 'Je veux envoyer un colis à Calavi' → reply with a card that opens /delivery with the address prefilled to Calavi.
AC4: 'Quel restaurant livre près de moi ?' → reply with ≥3 restaurant cards linking to their pages.
AC5: 'Combien ai-je dépensé cette semaine ?' → reply with a total computed from the actual store transactions (changes after a new payment) and a per-category breakdown.
AC6: Unrecognised input gets a helpful fallback reply with suggestion chips. Input matching is accent/case-insensitive.
